name: Buttonhole
description: Worked buttonholes cut upright in one column and crosswise in the next, evenly spaced down the placket.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; top: 14%; width: 40%; height: 72%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@x % 2 == 1) { :after { left: 14%; top: 30%; width: 72%; height: 40%; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
